density_source: https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/application-note/AN11491.pdf section 4.3: 10 pF/mm² example. 30 pF/mm² is an analyst-selected sensitivity, not a measured limit.
model: C=A*c_density. Each island is a capacitor between its assigned COM and SEG. Cell/electrode sums use full TOP/BOTTOM overlap, including routing. Same-layer fringing, external stray capacitance, alignment-layer effects and dielectric nonlinearity are not separately modeled. COM and SEG totals are two views of the same capacitors; do not add them.
